as_told.title: Joe McMoneagle's Legion of Merit for remote viewing

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that Joseph McMoneagle, a man he once interviewed, was given the Legion of Merit, a US military award, for his work in remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe faraway places using only the mind. Michels adds that McMoneagle was known as "remote viewer number one" and was one of the best. If true, it would mean the US Army officially honoured a psychic skill.
